subtitle: When Kanishka Tried to Lift the Sky with Stone and Faith

panels.shot: sweeping low-angle hero wide against an imagined skyline of Purushapura
panels.action: Kanishka I stands in regal Kushan robes and tall crown, hand raised toward an immense, ghostly outline of a stupa towering above Purushapura’s plains, mountains hazy beyond.

dialogue.text: In Purushapura, Kanishka the Kushan dreamed of a stupa whose height would carry the Buddha’s memory toward the sky.

i18n.hi: पुरुषपुरा में कुषाण राजा कनिष्क ने ऐसे स्तूप का सपना देखा जो बुद्ध की याद को आकाश तक पहुँचा दे।

panels.action: A grand view of the Kushan Empire at its height: caravans on the Silk Road, fortified cities, and Kanishka I on a balcony overlooking Purushapura’s bustling streets.

dialogue.text: In the second century of our era, the Kushan Empire stretched from the Oxus to the Ganga, and Purushapura, later Peshawar, beat as its heart.

i18n.hi: दूसरी सदी में कुषाण साम्राज्य ओक्सस से गंगा तक फैला था, और पुरुषपुरा, आगे चलकर पेशावर, उसका धड़कता दिल था।

panels.action: Inside a Kushan palace hall, Kanishka sits on a low throne amid monks and counselors; a scroll map of routes to Gandhara, Mathura and Central Asia lies open before him.

dialogue.text: Kanishka, conqueror and patron, listened to traders of the Silk Road and monks of many schools; power and doctrine met at his court.

i18n.hi: विजेता और संरक्षक कनिष्क रेशम मार्ग के व्यापारियों और अलग–अलग मठों के भिक्षुओं की सुनता था; ताकत और मत उसके दरबार में मिलते थे।

panels.action: Close on Kanishka’s intense, thoughtful face as he looks at a small reliquary held by a monk, its gleam reflected in his eyes.

dialogue.text: From the Sarvastivadin teachers, he heard of relics and stupas that turned memory into pilgrimage, stone into devotion.

i18n.hi: सर्वास्तिवाद आचार्यों से उसने सुना कि कैसे अवशेष और स्तूप यादों को यात्रा बनाते हैं, पत्थर को भक्ति।

panels.shot: epic wide shot of planning scene
panels.action: In an open courtyard, Kanishka stands over a ground plan scratched into packed earth: a vast cruciform base sketched beside smaller existing stupas; architects and monks watch.

dialogue.speaker: kanishka_i
dialogue.text: Let Purushapura hold a stupa so great, even distant lands remember.

i18n.hi: पुरुषपुरा में ऐसा स्तूप उठे कि दूर–दराज देश भी उसे याद रखें।

panels.action: Bird’s‑eye over Shah‑ji‑Dheri’s plain as foundations are dug: channels cut, stone blocks hauled, the outline of a massive cruciform base emerging in dust and morning light.

dialogue.text: Near Purushapura, at Shah-ji-Dheri, laborers carved into earth a cruciform base vast enough to bear a mountain of brick and faith.

i18n.hi: पुरुषपुरा के पास शाह–जी–डेरि पर मजदूरों ने मिट्टी काटकर इतना बड़ा क्रॉस–आकार आधार गढ़ा कि उस पर ईंट और आस्था का पहाड़ टिक सके।

panels.action: Kanishka walks through the half-built base, towering stone platforms rising around him; he touches the rough masonry while monks chant softly nearby.

dialogue.text: The base spread eighty-three paces in width, a measured cross upon the ground, built to anchor a soaring, stacked tower of relic-honoring tiers.

i18n.hi: आधार तिरासी कदम तक फैला, ज़मीन पर नपा–तुला क्रॉस, जिस पर अवशेषों को मान देने वाली परतों की ऊँची मीनार टिकनी थी।

panels.shot: intimate close-up on a small casket being crafted
panels.action: Artisans in fine detail carve a small metal casket with figures and Kharoshthi letters, while Kanishka watches, hands folded before him.

dialogue.text: Within, a reliquary casket was fashioned and inscribed, naming Kanishka as patron and tying his reign to the guardians of Sarvastivadin teaching.

i18n.hi: अंदर एक अवशेष–पेटी बनाई और लिखी गई, जिसमें कनिष्क को संरक्षक कहा गया और उसके शासन को सर्वास्तिवाद शिक्षकों के रखवालों से जोड़ा गया।

panels.action: In the dim core of the stupa base, Kanishka and monks lower the casket into a prepared niche, lamps flickering on stone, the world above feeling distant.

dialogue.speaker: kanishka_i
dialogue.text: Not my name, but the Buddha’s path must endure in this place.

i18n.hi: मेरा नाम नहीं, यहाँ बुद्ध का मार्ग टिकना चाहिए।

panels.shot: epic vertical wide showing the rising superstructure
panels.action: A towering brick and timber stupa rises in stages above the huge base, ringed by scaffolds; tiny figures of workers cling to its sides under a vast sky.

dialogue.text: Tier upon tier climbed into the air, a high stupa whose true height we can only estimate, but whose ambition rivaled the greatest monuments of its age.

i18n.hi: परत पर परत हवा में चढ़ती गई, ऐसा ऊँचा स्तूप बना जिसकी सही ऊँचाई हम बस आँकते हैं, पर जिसका जोश उस युग के सबसे बड़े स्मारकों को टक्कर देता है।

panels.shot: wide shot of distant pilgrims approaching
panels.action: Caravans from different lands—Central Asian riders, Indian monks, Chinese travelers—approach the stupa, its silhouette dominating the horizon above Purushapura.

dialogue.text: From many roads pilgrims came, guided by stories of Kanishka’s great stupa, its upper tiers glimmering in clear air above the city.

i18n.hi: कई रास्तों से यात्री आए, कनिष्क के महान स्तूप की कहानी से खिंचे, जिसके ऊपरी तल शहर के ऊपर साफ हवा में चमकते थे।

panels.shot: medium shot with imagined Chinese pilgrim juxtaposed
panels.action: Kanishka stands in serene satisfaction near the base, while in a faint overlay we see a later Chinese pilgrim, scroll in hand, gazing upward in awe.

dialogue.text: Centuries later, Faxian and Xuanzang wrote of this stupa in wonder, their words preserving a memory even as they stretched its height beyond measure.

i18n.hi: सदियों बाद फाशियन और ज़ुआनज़ांग ने इस स्तूप को देखकर लिखा, उनके शब्दों ने उसकी याद बचाए रखी, भले ही ऊँचाई को कल्पना से भी ऊपर खींच दिया।

panels.shot: close-up on Kanishka in solitary reflection
panels.action: Kanishka sits alone at dusk on a terrace, the stupa looming beyond, its top lost in fading light; his face shows both pride and unease.

dialogue.text: As its fame grew, the line between devotion and royal glory blurred, and Kanishka weighed whether the monument lifted hearts or merely his own name.

i18n.hi: जैसे–जैसे यश बढ़ा, भक्ति और राज–वैभव की रेखा धुंधली हुई, और कनिष्क सोचता रहा कि यह स्तूप दिल उठाता है या बस उसका अपना नाम।

panels.shot: somber wide shot of later decay
panels.action: Time passes in a visual montage: scaffolds gone, surfaces weathered; later ruins of the upper structure collapse, leaving the massive base scarred yet solid.

dialogue.text: Empires faded, earthquakes and neglect took their toll; the great superstructure fell, and only the broad base and buried relics endured beneath changing rulers.

i18n.hi: साम्राज्य ढले, भूकंप और अनदेखी का प्रहार हुआ; ऊँचा ढाँचा गिर गया, बस चौड़ा आधार और दबे अवशेष ही बदलते शासकों के नीचे टिके रहे।

panels.action: Early twentieth-century archaeologists and workers at Shah-ji-Dheri clear earth from a huge cruciform plinth; measuring staffs and notebooks lie nearby.

dialogue.text: In 1908–09, D.B. Spooner’s spades uncovered the vast cruciform base at Shah-ji-Dheri, its scale hinting at the vanished giant that once rose above it.

i18n.hi: 1908–09 में डी. बी. स्पूनर की फावड़ियों ने शाह–जी–डेरि पर विशाल क्रॉस–आकार आधार निकाला, जिसका पैमाना उस खोए हुए दैत्य का इशारा करता था जो कभी उस पर उठता था।

panels.shot: tight shot on the Kanishka Casket amid finds
panels.action: On a cloth spread over earth, the Kanishka Casket rests among pottery sherds and tools, its figures and Kharoshthi letters revealed under careful hands.

dialogue.text: The Kanishka Casket emerged, bearing a Kharoshthi inscription that tied it to the king and his Sarvastivadin teachers, even as later readings corrected old misread Greek names.

i18n.hi: कनिष्क पेटी बाहर आई, जिस पर खरोष्ठी लेख था जो इसे राजा और उसके सर्वास्तिवाद आचार्यों से जोड़ता था, जबकि बाद की पढ़ाइयों ने पुराने ग़लत ग्रीक नाम सुधारे।

panels.shot: wide comparative shot between Peshawar ruins and Surkh Kotal
panels.action: A split composition: the ruined base at Shah-ji-Dheri on one side, and Surkh Kotal’s stepped Kushan structures on the other, both standing under the same sun.

dialogue.text: At Surkh Kotal in Afghanistan, inscriptions and grand terraces spoke again of Kushan builders, even naming a designer Palamedes, showing an empire steeped in monumental craft.

i18n.hi: अफगानिस्तान के सुरख कotal पर शिलालेख और भव्य सीढ़ियाँ फिर कुषाण निर्माताओं की बात करते हैं, एक डिज़ाइनर पलामेदेस का नाम लेते हुए, दिखाते हैं कि यह साम्राज्य विराट निर्माण–कला में डूबा था।

panels.shot: reflective medium shot, Kanishka as remembered figure
panels.action: An imagined Kanishka stands amid ghostly outlines of his stupa, modern ruins at his feet and pilgrims’ silhouettes stretching into the distance.

dialogue.text: Kanishka’s stupa no longer stands, yet its base, its casket, and distant pilgrims’ words still point upward, turning a king’s ambition into a shared ladder of remembrance.

i18n.hi: कनिष्क का स्तूप अब खड़ा नहीं, पर उसका आधार, उसकी पेटी और दूर–दराज़ यात्रियों के शब्द आज भी ऊपर की ओर इशारा करते हैं, राजा की महत्वाकांक्षा को साझा यादों की सीढ़ी बनाते हुए।

title_i18n.hi: कनिष्क का आसमान स्तूप उठता है

subtitle_i18n.en: When Kanishka Tried to Lift the Sky with Stone and Faith
subtitle_i18n.hi: जब कनिष्क ने पत्थर और आस्था से आसमान उठाने की ठानी
